```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(pROC)
  library(qs2)
})
## dplyr verbs used unprefixed below (avoid masking by Seurat/Matrix/other packages)
select   <- dplyr::select;   filter    <- dplyr::filter;    mutate   <- dplyr::mutate
arrange  <- dplyr::arrange;  rename    <- dplyr::rename;    count    <- dplyr::count
summarise <- dplyr::summarise; group_by <- dplyr::group_by; distinct <- dplyr::distinct
pull     <- dplyr::pull;     inner_join <- dplyr::inner_join

## =========================================================
## Paths
## =========================================================
PROJECT_DIR <- "/path/to/project"
OBJ_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "objects")
OUTDIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "ext_DE_pseudo")          # DE / curation tables
dir.create(OUTDIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## =========================================================
## Inputs
##   - obj:        preprocessing/scrna/07_bonemarrowmap_annotation.R
##   - srsf2_nano: nanoranger calls of the SRSF2 cohort
## =========================================================
obj        <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(OBJ_DIR, "ext_obj_merge_filt_doublets_removed_norm_scaled_scvi_bonemarmap_passonly_finalanno.qs2"))
srsf2_nano <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(OBJ_DIR, "srsf2_nano_combined_filtered.qs2"))

## join the per-sample RNA layers once (pseudobulk + module scores need one counts/data layer)
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(obj[["RNA"]])
print(Layers(obj[["RNA"]]))

CELLTYPE_COL <- "BoneMarrowMap_CellType_Broad_final"
```

```{r subset nanoranger calls to cells in the Seurat object}
## srsf2_nano already in memory (tibble, 173,015 x 8)
cells_seurat <- colnames(obj)

## --- barcode-format sanity check (STOP if these don't overlap) ---
ov <- mean(unique(srsf2_nano$bc) %in% cells_seurat)
cat(sprintf("nano barcodes matching obj1 cells: %.1f%%\n", 100*ov))
cat("example nano bc :", head(srsf2_nano$bc, 3), "\n")
cat("example obj bc :", head(cells_seurat, 3), "\n")
if (ov < 0.05) stop("Barcode formats don't match — inspect the two 'example' lines above ",
                    "and reformat srsf2_nano$bc (or obj1 colnames) before continuing.")

## subset to genotyping records whose cell is in the Seurat object
srsf2_nano_filt <- srsf2_nano %>% dplyr::filter(bc %in% cells_seurat)
cat(sprintf("nano rows: %d -> %d (kept %d unique cells)\n",
            nrow(srsf2_nano), nrow(srsf2_nano_filt),
            dplyr::n_distinct(srsf2_nano_filt$bc)))
```

```{r SRSF2 status and cohort per cell}
cat("\nGenes genotyped in nano:\n"); print(sort(table(srsf2_nano_filt$gene), decreasing = TRUE))

## SRSF2 records only; collapse to one status per cell (mutated if ANY mutated record)
srsf2_status <- srsf2_nano_filt %>%
  filter(gene == "SRSF2") %>%
  group_by(bc) %>%
  summarise(srsf2_status = if_else(any(mutated == "mutated"), "mutated", "wildtype"),
            .groups = "drop")

cat("\nSRSF2 genotyped cells (that are in obj1):\n"); print(table(srsf2_status$srsf2_status))

## map onto obj (cells with no SRSF2 record -> NA)
obj$srsf2_status <- srsf2_status$srsf2_status[match(colnames(obj), srsf2_status$bc)]

## cohort / chemistry from orig.ident
oi <- as.character(obj$orig.ident)
obj$cohort <- dplyr::case_when(
  oi %in% c("HD1","HD2")                ~ "healthy_internal",
  oi %in% c("HD3","HD4","HD5","HD6")    ~ "healthy_external",   # GSE247531 CD34+ donors
  TRUE                          ~ "patient")
obj$chemistry <- ifelse(obj$cohort == "healthy_external", "v1_old", "GEMX")

cat("\nCohort x SRSF2 status:\n")
print(table(obj$cohort, obj$srsf2_status, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r pseudobulk DESeq2 functions}
## compartments to test (restricts both comparisons)
COMPARTMENTS <- c("HSCs", "GMPs", "MEPs", "Monocytes",
                  "Lymphoid progenitors", "Erythroid-like cells", "B-cells")

## ---- helper: build pseudobulk & run DESeq2 for one compartment ----
run_compartment_de <- function(obj, compartment, control_cohorts, tag) {

  md <- obj@meta.data %>% rownames_to_column("cell")

  ## assign each cell to MUTANT or HEALTHY (donor = orig.ident); else drop
  md <- md %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[CELLTYPE_COL]] == compartment) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(condition = case_when(
      cohort == "patient" & srsf2_status == "mutated" ~ "MUTANT",
      cohort %in% control_cohorts                     ~ "HEALTHY",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(condition))
  if (nrow(md) == 0) return(NULL)

  md$donor <- md$orig.ident

  ## keep donor groups with >= MIN_CELLS cells in this compartment
  keep_don <- md %>% dplyr::count(donor) %>% dplyr::filter(n >= MIN_CELLS) %>% dplyr::pull(donor)
  md <- md %>% dplyr::filter(donor %in% keep_don)

  ## need >= MIN_DONORS on BOTH sides
  nd <- md %>% dplyr::distinct(donor, condition) %>% dplyr::count(condition)
  if (!all(c("MUTANT","HEALTHY") %in% nd$condition) || any(nd$n < MIN_DONORS)) {
    message(sprintf("  [%s / %s] skipped — donors: %s",
                    tag, compartment,
                    paste(nd$condition, nd$n, collapse = ", ")))
    return(NULL)
  }

  ## ---- aggregate RAW counts to donor pseudobulk (genes x donors) ----
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[, md$cell, drop = FALSE]
  gf <- factor(md$donor)
  mm <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + gf)
  colnames(mm) <- levels(gf)
  pb <- as.matrix(counts %*% mm)                     # genes x donors

  ## coldata aligned to pseudobulk columns
  coldata <- md %>% distinct(donor, condition, chemistry) %>%
    column_to_rownames("donor")
  coldata <- coldata[colnames(pb), , drop = FALSE]
  coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition, levels = c("HEALTHY","MUTANT"))
  coldata$chemistry <- factor(coldata$chemistry)

  ## design: add chemistry only if it varies within this compartment
  design <- if (nlevels(droplevels(coldata$chemistry)) > 1)
              ~ chemistry + condition else ~ condition

  ## prefilter low-count genes (>=10 counts in >= MIN_DONORS donors)
  pb <- pb[rowSums(pb >= 10) >= MIN_DONORS, , drop = FALSE]

  ## ---- DESeq2 ----
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(pb, coldata, design = design)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition","MUTANT","HEALTHY"))
  res <- lfcShrink(dds, contrast = c("condition","MUTANT","HEALTHY"),
                   res = res, type = "ashr")         # shrink LFC for ranking

  out <- as.data.frame(res) %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    mutate(compartment = compartment,
           comparison  = tag,
           n_mutant    = sum(coldata$condition == "MUTANT"),
           n_healthy   = sum(coldata$condition == "HEALTHY"),
           design      = paste(deparse(design), collapse = ""))

  message(sprintf("  [%s / %s] OK — %d MUT vs %d HEALTHY donors, %d genes tested",
                  tag, compartment, out$n_mutant[1], out$n_healthy[1], nrow(out)))
  out
}

## ---- driver: loop whitelisted compartments for a given control set ----
run_all <- function(obj, control_cohorts, tag) {
  comps <- obj@meta.data %>%
    filter((cohort == "patient" & srsf2_status == "mutated") |
             cohort %in% control_cohorts) %>%
    pull(.data[[CELLTYPE_COL]]) %>% unique() %>% na.omit()
  comps <- intersect(COMPARTMENTS, comps)            # restrict to whitelist
  message("Testing compartments: ", paste(comps, collapse = ", "))

  res_list <- lapply(comps, function(cc)
    tryCatch(run_compartment_de(obj, cc, control_cohorts, tag),
             error = function(e){ message("  ERROR ", cc, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }))
  res <- bind_rows(res_list)

  if (nrow(res)) {
    write.csv(res, file.path(OUTDIR, sprintf("DE_%s_all_compartments.csv", tag)),
              row.names = FALSE)
    for (cc in unique(res$compartment)) {
      write.csv(filter(res, compartment == cc),
                file.path(OUTDIR,
                  sprintf("DE_%s_%s.csv", tag, gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+","_",cc))),
                row.names = FALSE)
    }
  }
  res
}
```

```{r run DE (SRSF2-mutant vs all controls)}
## MUTANT (SRSF2-mutant patient cells) vs ALL controls (HD1, HD2 + external GSE247531 donors HD3-HD6)
res_allctrl <- run_all(obj, control_cohorts = c("healthy_internal","healthy_external"),
                       tag = "vs_all_controls")

## quick significant-gene tally
sig_summary <- res_allctrl %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison, compartment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_sig_padj0.05 = sum(padj < 0.05),
            n_up   = sum(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0),
            n_down = sum(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0), .groups="drop")
write.csv(sig_summary, file.path(OUTDIR, "DE_significant_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(as.data.frame(sig_summary))
```

```{r curate significant genes per compartment}
## ============================================================
## SRSF2 per-compartment signature CURATION (no plots, no scoring)
## Uses: obj (cohort / srsf2_status), res_allctrl, CELLTYPE_COL, OUTDIR
## ============================================================
## ---------- CONSTANTS ----------
LFC_CUT        <- 1        # |log2FC| > 1
PADJ_CUT       <- 0.05
MIN_CELLS      <- 10       # donors with >= this many cells count toward group means / denominators
EXPR_PCT_CUT   <- 5        # % cells expressing to call a donor "expressing"
DOWN_EXT_RATIO <- 1.5      # keep DOWN gene iff (HDext+1)/(MUT+1) >= this  (== "external > mutant")
PSEUDO         <- 1        # CPM pseudocount for the ratio

## ---------- significant genes (vs all controls) for one compartment ----------
build_sig <- function(compartment, res_allctrl) {
  res_allctrl %>%
    filter(compartment == !!compartment) %>%
    select(gene, lfc_all = log2FoldChange, padj_all = padj) %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj_all), padj_all < PADJ_CUT, abs(lfc_all) > LFC_CUT) %>%
    mutate(direction   = ifelse(lfc_all > 0, "UP_in_MUTANT", "DOWN_in_MUTANT"),
           compartment = compartment) %>%
    arrange(direction, desc(abs(lfc_all)))
}

## ---------- per-donor expression diagnostic for a gene set in one compartment ----------
donor_diag <- function(obj, compartment, genes,
                       min_cells = MIN_CELLS, expr_pct_cut = EXPR_PCT_CUT) {
  genes <- intersect(unique(genes), rownames(obj))
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(NULL)

  md <- obj@meta.data %>% rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[CELLTYPE_COL]] == compartment) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(donor = as.character(orig.ident),
                  grp = dplyr::case_when(
                    cohort == "patient" & srsf2_status == "mutated" ~ "MUTANT",
                    cohort == "healthy_internal"                    ~ "HEALTHY_internal",
                    cohort == "healthy_external"                    ~ "HEALTHY_external",
                    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(grp))
  if (nrow(md) == 0) return(NULL)

  cnts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[genes, md$cell, drop = FALSE]
  tot  <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[,        md$cell, drop = FALSE]

  gf <- factor(md$donor)
  mm <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + gf); colnames(mm) <- levels(gf)
  pb_gene <- as.matrix(cnts %*% mm)                       # genes x donors: summed counts
  libsize <- as.numeric(Matrix::colSums(tot) %*% mm); names(libsize) <- colnames(mm)
  ncell_d <- as.numeric(Matrix::colSums(mm));           names(ncell_d) <- colnames(mm)
  nexpr   <- as.matrix(((cnts > 0) * 1) %*% mm)          # genes x donors: cells expressing

  cpm <- sweep(pb_gene, 2, libsize, "/") * 1e6
  pct <- sweep(nexpr,  2, ncell_d, "/") * 100
  donor_grp <- md %>% dplyr::distinct(donor, grp) %>% tibble::deframe()

  long <- as.data.frame(cpm) %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "donor", values_to = "cpm") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(as.data.frame(pct) %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
                       tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "donor", values_to = "pct_expr"),
                     by = c("gene","donor")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(as.data.frame(pb_gene) %>% rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
                       tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "donor", values_to = "raw_counts"),
                     by = c("gene","donor")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(grp = donor_grp[donor], n_cells = ncell_d[donor])

  ## per-gene summary; group means use only donors with >= min_cells
  summ <- long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_cpm_MUT   = mean(cpm[grp == "MUTANT"           & n_cells >= min_cells]),
      mean_cpm_HDint = mean(cpm[grp == "HEALTHY_internal" & n_cells >= min_cells]),
      mean_cpm_HDext = mean(cpm[grp == "HEALTHY_external" & n_cells >= min_cells]),
      n_mut_donors   = sum(grp == "MUTANT" & n_cells >= min_cells),
      n_mut_expr     = sum(grp == "MUTANT" & n_cells >= min_cells & pct_expr >= expr_pct_cut),
      top_donor_share= { r <- raw_counts[grp == "MUTANT"]; if (sum(r) > 0) max(r)/sum(r) else NA },
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      frac_mut_expr = ifelse(n_mut_donors > 0, n_mut_expr / n_mut_donors, NA),
      one_donor     = !is.na(top_donor_share) & top_donor_share > 0.6 & n_mut_expr <= 2)

  list(summary = summ, long = long)
}

## ---------- run curation for every compartment ----------
all_curated <- list()
for (cc in COMPARTMENTS) {
  sig <- build_sig(cc, res_allctrl)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) { message(sprintf("[%s] no significant genes", cc)); next }

  dd <- donor_diag(obj, cc, sig$gene)
  summ <- if (!is.null(dd)) dd$summary else
    data.frame(gene = sig$gene, mean_cpm_MUT = NA, mean_cpm_HDint = NA, mean_cpm_HDext = NA,
               n_mut_donors = NA, n_mut_expr = NA, top_donor_share = NA,
               frac_mut_expr = NA, one_donor = NA)

  tab <- sig %>%
    left_join(summ, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(
      ## objective down-gene rule: keep DOWN iff external clearly > mutant
      ratio_ext_mut = (mean_cpm_HDext + PSEUDO) / (mean_cpm_MUT + PSEUDO),
      ratio_int_mut = (mean_cpm_HDint + PSEUDO) / (mean_cpm_MUT + PSEUDO),   # shown, not used in filter
      keep_down = ifelse(direction == "DOWN_in_MUTANT",
                         ratio_ext_mut >= DOWN_EXT_RATIO, NA),
      ## final auto-keep: ALL up genes kept (you curate by hand); down genes gated by the rule
      keep_auto = ifelse(direction == "UP_in_MUTANT", TRUE, keep_down)
    ) %>%
    arrange(direction, desc(abs(lfc_all)))

  tagc <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cc)
  write.csv(tab, file.path(OUTDIR, sprintf("CURATE_%s.csv", tagc)), row.names = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(dd)) write.csv(dd$long, file.path(OUTDIR, sprintf("CURATE_%s_perdonor_long.csv", tagc)),
                              row.names = FALSE)
  all_curated[[cc]] <- tab

  n_up   <- sum(tab$direction == "UP_in_MUTANT")
  n_dn   <- sum(tab$direction == "DOWN_in_MUTANT")
  n_dnk  <- sum(tab$direction == "DOWN_in_MUTANT" & tab$keep_down, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("\n===== %s : %d UP (all kept for manual review) | %d DOWN -> %d pass external rule =====\n",
              cc, n_up, n_dn, n_dnk))
  print(tab %>%
          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 2))) %>%
          select(gene, direction, lfc_all, padj_all,
                 mean_cpm_MUT, mean_cpm_HDint, mean_cpm_HDext,
                 frac_mut_expr, top_donor_share, one_donor,
                 ratio_ext_mut, keep_down, keep_auto) %>%
          as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)
}

all_curated_df <- bind_rows(all_curated)
write.csv(all_curated_df, file.path(OUTDIR, "CURATE_ALL_compartments.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\nWrote CURATE_<compartment>.csv (+ _perdonor_long.csv) for %d compartments, plus CURATE_ALL_compartments.csv\n",
            length(all_curated)))

#remove mito/ribo/sex genes
TECH <- list(
  mito      = grepl("^MT-", all_curated_df$gene),
  ribo      = grepl("^RP[SL]|^RPLP|^RPSA", all_curated_df$gene),
  malat_neat= all_curated_df$gene %in% c("MALAT1","NEAT1"), #classic ambient/quality markers
  sex       = all_curated_df$gene %in% c("XIST","RPS4Y1","DDX3Y","UTY","KDM5D",
                "EIF1AY","USP9Y","ZFY","TXLNGY","NLGN4Y","TMSB4Y","PRKY","KDM6A")
)
hit <- Reduce(`|`, TECH)
# among the genes you'd actually keep:
all_curated_df[hit, c("gene","compartment","direction","lfc_all","padj_all")]
```

```{r HSC SRSF2 signature}
## final HSC signature (manually curated from CURATE_HSCs.csv)
## UP: IL1RAP, F13A1, PLD1, CNKSR2, PRKCD, HOMER3, CFD, COL4A5, ANKRD18B
## DOWN: AVP, ALDH1A1, CDH7, TNFSF4, SH3BP5, ABI3BP

## ============================================================
## HSC SRSF2 signature — scoring, validation, publication plots
## Assumes in memory: obj (with cohort / srsf2_status), all_curated_df
## Produces: donor-level Wilcoxon, per-cell AUROC, final gene CSV
## (figure panels: figure6_srsf2_hsc_signature_plots.Rmd)
## ============================================================

## ---------- config ----------
COMP    <- "HSCs"
UP      <- c("IL1RAP","F13A1","PLD1","CNKSR2","PRKCD","HOMER3","CFD","COL4A5","ANKRD18B")
DOWN    <- c("AVP","ALDH1A1","CDH7","TNFSF4","SH3BP5","ABI3BP")
CTCOL   <- "BoneMarrowMap_CellType_Broad_final"
TAG     <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", COMP)

## ---------- helpers ----------
class2 <- function(cohort, status) dplyr::case_when(
  cohort == "patient" & status == "mutated"            ~ "MUTANT",
  cohort %in% c("healthy_internal","healthy_external") ~ "HEALTHY",
  TRUE                                                 ~ NA_character_)

## ---------- inspect final gene table ----------
d <- all_curated_df %>%
  filter(compartment == COMP, keep_auto) %>%
  arrange(direction, desc(abs(lfc_all))) %>%
  select(gene, direction, lfc_all, padj_all,
         mean_cpm_MUT, mean_cpm_HDint, mean_cpm_HDext, frac_mut_expr)
print(data.frame(lapply(d, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) round(x, 2) else x)), row.names = FALSE)

## ============================================================
## 1. Score within compartment -> validation (donor Wilcoxon + per-cell AUROC)
## ============================================================
sub <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[which(obj@meta.data[[CTCOL]] == COMP)])
sub <- AddModuleScore(sub, features = list(intersect(UP,   rownames(sub))), name = "UPm",   seed = 1)
sub <- AddModuleScore(sub, features = list(intersect(DOWN, rownames(sub))), name = "DOWNm", seed = 1)
sub$SIG_score <- sub$UPm1 - sub$DOWNm1
sub$class     <- class2(sub$cohort, sub$srsf2_status)

md <- sub@meta.data %>%
  mutate(donor = as.character(orig.ident),
         class = class2(cohort, srsf2_status)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(class)) %>%
  mutate(class  = factor(class, levels = c("MUTANT","HEALTHY")),
         is_mut = as.integer(class == "MUTANT"))

## donor means (unit the Wilcoxon tests + dots on the violin)
donor_mean <- md %>%
  group_by(donor, class) %>%
  summarise(score = mean(SIG_score), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lab = donor)

w <- wilcox.test(score ~ class, data = donor_mean)
cat(sprintf("Donor Wilcoxon MUT(%d) vs HEALTHY(%d): p=%.5g\n",
            sum(donor_mean$class=="MUTANT"), sum(donor_mean$class=="HEALTHY"), w$p.value))
roc_obj <- pROC::roc(md$is_mut, md$SIG_score, quiet = TRUE, ci = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Per-cell AUROC = %.3f (%.3f-%.3f)\n",
            as.numeric(roc_obj$auc), roc_obj$ci[1], roc_obj$ci[3]))

## ============================================================
## 2. Save final gene list
## ============================================================
write.csv(data.frame(gene = c(UP, DOWN),
                     direction = rep(c("UP","DOWN"), c(length(UP), length(DOWN)))),
          file.path(OUTDIR, sprintf("SIG_%s_final_genes.csv", TAG)), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Saved SIG_%s_final_genes.csv\n", TAG))
```
